topic: ADHD: the full picture, ad (paid ad creative)
caption:
ADHD in adults: easy to miss, and easy to mistake for something else.

Adults diagnosed with ADHD later in life often describe years of struggle, and sometimes being treated for other conditions, such as anxiety or low mood, first. And poor sleep, stress or thyroid problems can look like ADHD. The Australian ADHD guideline says a diagnosis should not rest on questionnaires alone.

Our adult ADHD assessment is built around that guideline. It looks at your history back to childhood, your health and sleep, daily life, and input from someone who knows you, if you choose. You receive a full written report, a letter for your GP and, if you want to discuss medication, a report for a psychiatrist.

We developed our psychiatry pathway with Dr Luisa Fernandez of North Psychiatry, so with a GP referral the next step is already in place, if you choose it.

Kew, Croydon and online. Learn more at equalpsychology.com.au/services/adhd-assessment

Fees: $720 for the assessment and written reports. No Medicare rebate applies. Psychiatrist fees are separate and set by the psychiatrist.

Research:
Australian ADHD Professionals Association. (2022). Australian evidence-based clinical practice guideline for ADHD. https://adhdguideline.aadpa.com.au/
